hints.title: Prefix Tree Node Counting
hints.text: Every distinct substring of s corresponds to a unique node in a trie built from all suffixes of s.

hints.title: Suffix Insertion
hints.text: Iterate over every starting index i from 0 to len(s) - 1 and insert characters s[i..j] sequentially.

hints.title: Counting New Allocations
hints.text: Increment total count whenever a new transition edge or node is created in the prefix structure.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Inserts all N suffixes into a trie, taking at most N^2 node creations and character checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Storing full string substrings in a hash set requires O(N^3) time and O(N^3) memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trie representation deduplicates shared prefixes without repeated substring copying.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Suffix insertion into a trie with node counting.
